title: Sharp weighted two point contraction
statement: Let $p,\lambda,u,v\in\bbr$ satisfy $1<p<2$ and $0<\lambda<1/2$. Then $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho(p/(p-1),\lambda)^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le\big(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p\big)^{2/p}$, where $\rho(q,\lambda)$ denotes the sharp discrete hypercontractive radius.
replaced: Let $1<p<2$, $0<\lambda<1/2$, and $u,v\in\bbr$. Setting $\rho=\rho_*(p/(p-1),\lambda)$, one has $(\lambda u+(1-\lambda)v)^2+\rho^2\lambda(1-\lambda)(u-v)^2\le(\lambda|u|^p+(1-\lambda)|v|^p)^{2/p}$. Here $\rho_*(q,\lambda)=\sqrt{\sinh(\ell/q)/\sinh(\ell/(q/(q-1)))}$ with $\ell=\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)$.
